fields.description: Florine Beach Residences offers apartments and larger duplex homes at Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. The four-tower layout faces the lagoon, open landscape and golf-course setting, with outlook varying by apartment position. The reviewed brochure identifies Tower D as the fully furnished collection, rather than applying that description to every home.

overview: The three-bedroom Type A duplex adds a study and maid’s room to its two-level layout. Its total includes balcony area. The brochure gives an area range, whereas the webpage displays only one endpoint; a unit-specific drawing is more useful than a generic bedroom-size label.
research.locationNote: Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Island golf, marina and leisure facilities are wider master-community amenities; their access and opening arrangements need confirmation.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 1,930,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder gives 20% launch deposit, 40% during construction and 40% on handover. Exact milestone dates and any promotional option were not verified in an accessible developer payment sheet.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports September 2028. The reviewed project brochure contains no explicit contractual completion date. Confirm the selected tower and SPA.
unresolved: The webpage shows 1,988.20 sq ft for three-bedroom Type A; the original brochure spans 1,988.20–2,026.41 sq ft. Furnishing is explicitly Tower D in the brochure; it is not inferred for the other towers.
Current unit availability, signed payment dates, final specification and applicable service charges require developer/unit-specific confirmation.
